scope: Restore a narrow AC1021 GROUP reference to one emitted ordinary model-space 2D/3D POLYLINE VERTEX when the vertex has exactly one matching, pre-registered GROUP reactor and the GROUP itself matches the independently observed single-member metadata profile. The child remains absent from BLOCK_HEADER ownership. Parent targets and all non-profile GROUP paths retain their existing behavior; SEQEND remains refused by the new path.
authority: ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1 §§20.4.16–17 define the POLYLINE's R2004+ VERTEX/SEQEND hard-owned references; §20.4.52 defines BLOCK_HEADER-owned entities; §20.4.72 defines GROUP member hard pointers. These layouts alone do not qualify an arbitrary GROUP/object graph.

source_controls.provenance: Locally authored ezdxf 1.4.5 R2007 POLYLINE and GROUP; to exercise child targeting, the scratch DXF GROUP 340 tag was explicitly retargeted from the parent to a VERTEX or SEQEND and its persistent reactor moved to that child. ODA File Converter 27.1.0 converted these scratch DXFs to DWG and back to DXF without .err. This is a controlled producer/reader observation, not a claim about a native CAD user's authoring workflow. No DWG/DXF fixtures are added.
source_controls.independent_observation: GNU LibreDWG 0.14 reports the GROUP's hard-pointer role 5 to VERTEX 0x32, that child's owner role 4 to POLYLINE 0x2F and reciprocal reactor role 4 to GROUP 0x34; the model BLOCK_HEADER contains the POLYLINE parent only. GROUP owner and single reactor are the containing dictionary and the XDictionary is absent. ODA-returned raw DXF preserves the same GROUP 340 target and child owner/reactor. The analogous SEQEND control also preserves its target, but the current writer synthesizes SEQEND without source metadata, so it is deliberately not admitted by this change.
source_controls.consumer_limit: ezdxf 1.4.5's high-level GROUP loader filters the child member as not being a layout entity, even though ODA's raw DXF contains the correct 340 reference. The peer audit intentionally parses raw DXF tags and does not claim high-level ezdxf GROUP membership support.

implementation: For the existing bounded AC1021 ordinary model-space compound path, the writer accepts only pre-registered GROUP identities and exactly one vertex reactor. It verifies the committed parent frame's hard-owner child/SEQEND tail and the committed vertex frame's owner/reactor handle prefix against the actual identities before staging a (vertex,GROUP) pair. A bounded ledger/index is restored by compound and outer transaction rollback; caller edits after emission cannot refresh this evidence. GROUP admission additionally requires one member, empty description, named/selectable defaults, zero flags, its dictionary owner as the sole reactor, missing XDictionary, and no app-data/EED/storage. Only that new GROUP profile selects bit-exact AC1021 GROUP string/footer and handle assembly; all other GROUP paths retain their prior framing. The exact committed frame receipt check also prevents qualifying a reactor when common-header emission is compiled out.

generated_outputs.provenance: The fixture-free C++ test writer generated the final production AC1021 2D and 3D DWGs with the existing opt-in material and plotstyle graphs. ODA File Converter 27.1.0 produced both DXFs without .err.
generated_outputs.independent_audit: tools/audit_ac1021_polyline_group_peer.py hash-checks each DWG and DXF before/after audit, invokes LibreDWG JSON, and verifies source version, unique identities, GROUP role-5 member, role-3 parent-owned ordered vertices/SEQEND, role-4 vertex owner/reactor, parent-only BLOCK_HEADER membership, and coordinates. It also verifies the raw ODA DXF GROUP member, GROUP owner/reactor, child owner/reactor and 2D/3D coordinates. The source2d, generated2d and generated3d profiles pass.

validation.result: 5/5 passed. 2D/3D controls cover matching single reactor, parent target, immutable post-write mutation, missing/wrong/duplicate/additional reactor, metadata mismatches, SEQEND refusal, identity collision, compound and outer rollback, early/late exceptions, required failure latch, prior-destination preservation and retry. Existing paper-space acceptance is regression-tested as unchanged; it is not newly qualified. Peer audit positive and corrupted-target/owner/reactor/role/coordinate/block-list controls pass.
validation.addressSanitizer: ctest --test-dir build-asan-custom -R '^libdxfrw_dwg_ac1021_polyline_group_targets$' --output-on-failure: 1/1 passed after rebuilding the final production and C++ test candidate.

remaining: Qualify SEQEND metadata retention, GROUP with multiple members or reactors, late group registration, paper/named-block and other-version graph closure independently. The later paper/named membership change supersedes the historical paper-space acceptance mentioned in validation: GROUP references to paper/named POLYLINE vertices now fail closed; see p6-ac1021-polyline-paper-named-membership-2026-11-04.json. Native application semantics and general complete-file DWG support remain open. The evidence and admission validate the selected target vertex reactor and the GROUP member tail; they do not assert that no other emitted object carries a reactor referencing the same GROUP.
